title: Count Word Occurrences
description: Read an integer n, then n words, then one query word, and print how many times the query appears among the n words. A query that never appears counts 0: look the key up safely (guard or default) instead of indexing a missing key, which raises KeyError. This problem establishes the C6 base skill of dictionary frequency counting with missing-key handling.
constraints: Each word has 1 to 50 lowercase letters.
starter_code:
def count_word(words, query):
    """Return how many times query appears in words."""
    # TODO: count with a dict and look the query up safely (0 when absent)
    raise NotImplementedError


def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    words = data[1:1 + n]
    query = data[1 + n]
    print(count_word(words, query))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
input_format: First line: an integer n. Second line: n words separated by spaces. Third line: one query word.
output_format: A single integer: occurrences of the query (0 when absent).
